description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grains, specifically testing the behavior of stuck grains, activation collection, and deactivation handling within the Orleans runtime. It defines a test class 'StuckGrainTests' with multiple test methods, and includes a nested fixture class for setting up the test cluster configuration.

classes.name: StuckGrainTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for Orleans grains, focusing on stuck grain detection, activation, and deactivation scenarios.

classes.description: A fixture class for setting up the Orleans test cluster with specific configuration options.
